rules: not required for active actor, enemy, map, hazard, or skill rendering
sprite sheets are not part of the active runtime path

priority: Pixi Graphics neon vector renderer is the primary path for actors, enemies, hazards, world, and skill effects
geometry, particles, trails, and procedural primitives are preferred over pixel or SVG sprites
generatedAssets entries document procedural neon keys only
external actor and skill spritesheets are not required for active gameplay rendering
code-generated texture fallback is allowed only for tiny shared primitives
texturePolicy.descriptorMissing: No external descriptor is required; use procedural neon renderer output.
texturePolicy.descriptorFailure: Keep procedural neon rendering active and report through renderer diagnostics.
texturePolicy.skillEffects: Pixi Graphics neon vector effects are the only active skill effect path. External spritesheet and Canvas 2D skill rendering are not used while Pixi is active.

textureKeyGuide.common: shadow | reticle | xp | chest | warning-ring | slash-arc | burst | beam

generatedAssets.description: Primary actors are drawn by Pixi Graphics neon symbols.
Primary enemies are drawn by role-specific neon silhouettes.
Primary skill effects are drawn by geometry, particles, and trails.
